// Isolated browser acceptance fixture; copied beneath Platform/.local to use
// internal application interfaces. The HTTP handler and workers are production.
package main
import (
 "context"
 "encoding/json"
 "fmt"
 "os"
 "os/signal"
 "syscall"
 "time"
 "competition2026/product/platform/internal/app"
 "competition2026/product/platform/internal/store"
 "competition2026/product/platform/pkg/model"
)
func main() {
 ctx, cancel := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), os.Interrupt, syscall.SIGTERM); defer cancel()
 mode := os.Getenv("SF_FIXTURE_MODE"); if mode == "" { mode = "cloud" }
 command := os.Getenv("SF_FIXTURE_COMMAND")
 jobID := os.Getenv("SF_FIXTURE_JOB_ID"); if jobID == "" { jobID = "frontend:retry/with-identity" }
 application, err := app.Open(ctx, app.Options{Mode:mode, NodeID:"frontend-phase2-"+mode, Address:os.Getenv("SF_FIXTURE_LISTEN"), DSN:os.Getenv("SF_FIXTURE_DSN"), KeyFile:os.Getenv("SF_FIXTURE_KEY"), StaticDir:os.Getenv("SF_FIXTURE_STATIC"), BootstrapPassword:os.Getenv("SF_FIXTURE_PASSWORD"), Seed:command=="run"})
 if err != nil { panic(err) }; defer application.Close()
 if application.Store.Driver == "pgx" { application.Store.DB.SetMaxOpenConns(3); application.Store.DB.SetMaxIdleConns(1) }
 if command == "repair" {
  doc, err := application.Store.Get(ctx, "job", jobID); if err != nil { panic(err) }
  job, err := store.Decode[model.Job](doc); if err != nil { panic(err) }
  job.FromMS = 1800000000000; job.ToMS = 1800000002000
  job.Status = "failed"
  job.Version = doc.Version+1
  _, err = application.Store.Put(ctx, "job", job.ID, doc.Version, job); if err != nil { panic(err) }
  fmt.Println("repaired range; original task identity retained"); return
 }
 if command == "inspect" {
  snapshot := map[string]any{}
  for _, kind := range []string{"job","definition","draft","state","alarm","audit"} {
   docs, err := application.Store.List(ctx,kind); if err != nil { panic(err) }; snapshot[kind] = docs
  }
  if err := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(snapshot); err != nil { panic(err) }; return
 }
 if command == "enqueue" {
  _, err := application.Store.Ingest(ctx, store.IngestBatch{MessageID:"frontend-retry-history", SourceID:"frontend-fixture", Critical:true, Event:map[string]any{"kind":"browser-acceptance"}, Points:[]model.Observation{{ID:"frontend-retry-point",DeviceID:"counter-1",Key:"pulse",Value:1,ObservedMS:1800000001000,Quality:"GOOD",TimeSource:"simulation",Unit:"piece"}}}); if err != nil { panic(err) }
  job := model.Job{ID:jobID, TaskID:"recompute:"+jobID+":1", Kind:"recompute", Status:"pending", FromMS:0, ToMS:1800000002000, DeviceID:"counter-1", DefinitionID:"goods-count", Reason:"frontend browser retry acceptance", Version:1}
  _, err = application.Store.Put(ctx,"job",job.ID,0,job); if err != nil { panic(err) }
  fmt.Println("queued invalid-range job through production Store.Put"); return
 }
 if command != "run" { panic("unknown fixture command") }
 policy := application.Store.Policy(); policy.Archive.Enabled=false; application.Store.SetPolicy(policy)
 _ = time.Now()
 if err := application.Run(ctx); err != nil { panic(err) }
}
